verdict.rationale: The only bulk-write evidence is the CreateNexus endpoint, which "creates one or more new nexus declarations" in a single call. The MCP server can also list transactions with filters, which is a bulk read rather than a bulk write. Nothing shows batch creation, adjustment, voiding or committing of transactions across many items. Missing for 10: a documented batch/bulk transaction API, bulk updates or voids across many records, agent/MCP-driven bulk actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
